transfer.stem: Which preparation follows this new homework plan?
transfer.passage:
TUESDAY HOMEWORK PLAN
Do exercises 2 and 3 on page 12 of your English textbook. Write the answers in your notebook; do not tear a page out of the textbook. Use two blank sheets of paper for your first draft and one more blank sheet for a clean copy. Write the clean copy with a blue pen. If you need a library seat for Tuesday, book it online before Monday evening.

options.text: Open the textbook at page 12 and prepare three blank sheets of paper.
Open the textbook at page 2 and do exercise 12.
Prepare only two blank sheets, because the clean copy needs no extra paper.
Tear a page out of the textbook and write the answers on it.

answer.display: Open the textbook at page 12 and prepare three blank sheets of paper.

explanation.strategy: 先把题号与页码分开，再把草稿和誊写的用纸相加。

steps.text: 翻到第12页，做第2题和第3题。
steps.reason: exercises2and3是两道题的编号；on page12才是页码。

steps.text: 准备三张空白纸：草稿两张，誊写再加一张。
steps.reason: two blank sheets加one more blank sheet等于三张；more表示在原有数量上增加。

distractors.reason: 交换了题号与页码：记录要求第12页的第2、3题，不是第2页的第12题。
漏掉了one more blank sheet，誊写另需一张，总共三张。
记录明确说在notebook写答案，并要求do not tear a page out of the textbook。

explanation.pitfall: page12不是第12题；one more表示额外增加，不能漏算。
